title: This sign-in could not be started
refusal.STS-LAUNCH-0001: There is no application {app} in this realm, so there is nothing to sign you in to.
refusal.STS-LAUNCH-0002: {protocol} is not a protocol a sign-in can be started in. A link here starts saml2, saml11, wsfed or oidc.
refusal.STS-LAUNCH-0003: This application does not sign in with {protocol}.
refusal.STS-LAUNCH-0004: This application can be started in more than one protocol, and the link does not say which.
refusal.STS-LAUNCH-0005: This application cannot be started from here. Start the sign-in at the application itself.
refusal.STS-LAUNCH-0006: This application has no address registered to send you to, so a sign-in started here has nowhere to go.
refusal.STS-LAUNCH-0007: The link names an address to send you to that is not registered for this application, so it was refused.
refusal.general: This sign-in could not be started.
background: This link starts a sign-in at this identity provider for an application (identity-provider-initiated sign-in). No application has been sent anything yet, so the problem is reported here instead.
